overview: BFS/DFS, topological order, MST cut property, adjacency-list complexity, sink detection, algorithm-complexity matching.
coreConcept: Graph algorithms ki time complexity representation (matrix vs list) par depend karti hai. Cut property MST ke liye key hai.
hinglishExplanation: Adjacency matrix me sink jaisi cheez O(V) me mil sakti hai (matrix scan smartly). Cut property: kisi bhi cut me lightest edge MST me hoti hai (distinct weights). Topological order sirf DAG me.
formalDefinition: Graph algorithms ki time complexity representation (matrix vs list) par depend karti hai. Cut property MST ke liye key hai.
importantProperties: Cut property: cut ka minimum edge MST me.
Sink in adjacency matrix: O(V) checks.
Adjacency list undirected me har edge ke do entries.
standardTechniques: Property ko chhoti graph par test karo.
